params.1266: So That's What Ess Stands For
params.1274: Click on any of the mineral veins to mine some essence.
params.1275: (If you need to get back to the Essence Mine, find Carwen in her shop and talk to her.)
params.2225: To leave the Essence Mine, find one of the glowing portals and step on it. This takes you back to wherever you came from.
